description: The price in credits of researching and writing messages for the chosen fit people (per person, total, the most it may hold), the balance, and who is skipped. Free. Its `credits` is the confirm_credits of start_outreach. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/outreach/quote]

cids.description: Fit people (cid) of the search; get_outreach lists them.

generation_id.description: The outreach generation id (get_outreach campaign.generation.id); omitted: the current one.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.
